Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead found; every source places the institution in Dnipro (not occupied territory). Addresses differ between sources: osvita.ua gives вул. Дзяка Георгія, 3; the IAU/WHED entry gives Севастопольська, 17. education.ua shows a 2026 admission cycle (applications 19 July–1 August), which is a lead that it is still operating. A possible rename to «Європейський медичний університет» (European Medical University) appears on education.ua; no official decision, date or legal basis for the rename was found.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Three different names in circulation (Conventional/Alternative vs Traditional/Non-Traditional vs European Medical University); the rename is attested only by education.ua and one medical-education blog, no official source found
